title: Patch: the weaker ladder bots make plausible mistakes instead of uniformly random moves
thread:
**Issue #2214 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2214: Patch: the weaker ladder bots make plausible mistakes instead of uniformly random moves
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When the ranked queue is empty, a player is paired with one of the server's bots. The weakest bot, the one a new player meets first, makes a completely random legal move every time: it ends its turn at random, attacks whatever it can and plays cards wherever they fit. The next two bots do the same on three moves in four, and on one move in two. A new player wins those games, but the opponent looks broken, and it gives away that it is a bot, which the terms of service say ranked does not reveal. Once this is built, a weak bot's mistakes come from moves a simple player would consider. It still loses most games, but it plays like a beginner rather than at random.

## Why
- The five `BOT_STRENGTHS` (`crates/server/src/config.rs:1166-1211`) have skill 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and a full-skill top.
- R747000's knob (`crates/ai/src/skill.rs:1-7`) hands each missed decision to `random_action` (`crates/server/src/bots/seat.rs:166-201`). §10.7's random policy (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/ai_policy.rs:60-90`) ends the turn with `AI_END_TURN_PROBABILITY` and otherwise picks uniformly among every other legal action.
- At skill 0.0, `plays_best` is always false, so strength 0's search budget, temperature and missed-lethal chance (`config.rs:1168-1182`) never shape a single move. `docs/bot-calibration.md:283-285` says the same: 'Strength 0 is the random policy'.
- New players start at `RATING_START` 1000 (`config.rs:439`). Strength 0's seed rating, 1216 (`BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `config.rs:1162`), is the bot rating closest to a new player.
- §9.12 (`spec/09-architecture.md:63`) says the terms allow pairing a player with an AI opponent and name no seat.
- The skill knob exists because budgets and temperatures alone spread the strengths by only about 126 Elo (`docs/bot-calibration.md:295-300`). Any replacement must keep that spread.

## Proposal
- Keep the skill roll and its random stream. On a miss, sample a weighted move instead of a uniform one. The legal actions are scored by the one-ply greedy baseline's evaluation (`greedy_action`, `crates/ai/src/baselines.rs`) and drawn by a softmax at a named temperature. A miss is then usually a weak but sensible move and sometimes a bad one. End turn is weighed like any other action, not by a fixed chance.
- The miss's temperature is a named constant in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, or a field of `BotStrength`. The miss still knows nothing about any card, which keeps the point of `skill.rs:1-7`.
- Re-measure the skill curve and the bots:
  - the skill curve with `cargo jackioh arena` (`crates/tools/src/arena.rs` and `crates/ai/src/match_.rs` read the knob too);
  - every pair of strengths with `jackioh-server bot-calibrate` (`crates/server/README.md:681-730`).
- Tune the miss temperature and the skills until neighbouring strengths are at least as far apart as now. Paste the new `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` and `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` rows, with the runs, into `docs/bot-calibration.md`.
- A ruling in this issue's block revising R747000's miss, with §9.12 and §10.7 edited where they name it.

## Where it lands
- AI: `crates/ai/src/skill.rs`, `crates/ai/src/baselines.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.
- Server: `crates/server/src/bots/seat.rs`, `crates/server/src/bots/calibrate.rs`, `crates/server/src/config.rs` (`BOT_STRENGTHS`, `BOT_SEED_RATINGS`, `SKILL_ELO_TABLE`).
- Tools: `crates/tools/src/arena.rs`, if it names the miss.
- Docs: `docs/bot-calibration.md`.
- Spec: SPEC §9.12 and §10.7 (`spec/09-architecture.md`, `spec/10-engine-guide.md`), R747000, and a new note in `spec/rulings/` with its paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A miss's action is always legal and drawn on the bot's own stream, so a seeded bot game replays. A test checks this for a strength-0 seat over seeded positions.
- [ ] Over a fixed set of seeded positions, a strength-0 miss is far less likely than `random_action` to end the turn with an affordable card in hand, or to make an attack the greedy baseline scores below doing nothing. The test prints both rates on failure, and the PR quotes them.
- [ ] A `bot-calibrate` run recorded in `docs/bot-calibration.md` shows every neighbouring pair of strengths still apart, with errors.
- [ ] `r747000_strength_seed_ratings_match_skill_curve` (`crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs:742`) passes on the new rows.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.

## Size and risks
Hard: two crates and a ruling, plus calibration runs of many games.
- At a useful size the runs take hours.
- The strengths' Elo offsets move, so the bots already in the pool drift to new ratings over their next games (R610).
- A one-ply evaluation per miss costs more than a uniform draw, though far less than the search a hit already runs.
- The practice AI does not use the skill knob, so practice play does not change.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40690937349)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A ladder bot's skill miss stops drawing uniformly from `random_action` and instead samples the legal actions by the greedy baseline's one-ply scores through a softmax at a new named temperature, keeping the skill roll, its stream discipline, and hidden-information Garage. The change re-tunes the miss temperature (and skills only if needed) so every neighbouring pair of `BOT_STRENGTHS` stays at least as far apart as now, re-measures the skill curve and the calibration, pastes the new `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` / `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` rows with their runs into `docs/bot-calibration.md`, and records the revision as R2214000 with §9.12 / §10.7 edits.

## Steps

1. Re-read SPEC §9.12 Bots, §10.7 AI policy, `spec/rulings/R747000.md`, `docs/bot-calibration.md` Results, and `crates/server/README.md` Skill to Elo. Confirm `spec/rulings/` holds no `R2214*.md`.
2. `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: add `/// R2214000: softmax temperature of the skill miss, in evaluation points` + `pub const AI_SKILL_MISS_TEMPERATURE: f64 = 8.0;` (starting point for tuning, rule 9). Fix `AI_SKILL_MIN` doc: 0.0 plays the weighted miss at every decision.
3. `crates/ai/src/baselines.rs`: add `skill_miss_action`, copying `greedy_action`'s opening: `None` if `!ai_to_act` (no draw); decline an unanswered draw offer; answer a mulligan via `mulligan_keep`. Else determinize once exactly like `greedy_action` (`match_shown_cost: Some(false)`). List actions from the true state with `candidate_set(state, seat)` (legal by construction, no card text read); empty gives `None`, one gives it with no further draw. Score each: `EndTurn` scores `evaluate(&det, seat, NextSwing::Enemy, &GREEDY_EVAL)` (standing still, weighed equally); others go through `simulate_first_answers` on `&det` with a counter sized as `greedy_action`'s, unscorable ones skipped; if none scorable, fall back exactly as `greedy_action` does (EndTurn, else first). Softmax at `AI_SKILL_MISS_TEMPERATURE` mirroring `decide.rs::pick_finalist` (`e^((score-best)/T)`, one `rng.next()` draw, first running sum past it); `T <= 0.0` returns the best with no draw. Decisions: single shared temperature (rejected: a per-strength field, five numbers to tune and calibrate) and a true-state action list (rejected: scoring the det world's list, whose pick the true state can refuse).
4. `crates/ai/src/skill.rs` docs, `crates/ai/src/match_.rs` (`choose_for`: miss arm calls `skill_miss_action(state, seat, rng)`; `Random` arm keeps `random_action`), and `crates/ai/README.md` skill paragraph: "the rest" is the weighted miss, still card-blind (only `GREEDY_EVAL`'s public scores on a redaction).
5. `crates/server/src/bots/seat.rs` (`play`: miss arm calls `skill_miss_action(&state, seat, &mut ai_rng)`; keep the draw-offer arm above it, the `r188_forbidden` filter and `fallback_action`), `crates/server/src/bots/calibrate.rs` (`play_game`: same one-line swap), `crates/tools/src/arena.rs` (`choose_for`: skilled-miss arm calls `skill_miss_action` on the referee state; `Random` unchanged). Update module docs naming the miss.
6. Tests. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/skill.rs`, rewrite `r747000_zero_skill_equals_random_controller`: skill-0 reproduces, `decisions == 0`, log differs from `Random` (the behavior R2214000 mandates; not a weakening). In `crates/tools/src/arena.rs` tests, rename `r747000_a_zero_skill_agent_plays_as_random_does` to `r2214000_a_zero_skill_agent_reproduces_but_differs_from_random` with matching asserts. In `crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs`, update `r747000_bot_seat_applies_strength_skill`'s skill-0 arm to expect `skill_miss_action` on the bot stream. Add `r2214000_strength_zero_miss_is_legal_and_replays` (miss over seeded positions is always in `legal_actions`, identical on a replayed stream; skill-0 `play` reproduces) and `r2214000_strength_zero_miss_makes_fewer_beginner_mistakes` (below).
7. Cheap gates now: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` (same for `-p jackioh-server`, `-p jackioh-tools`); `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai skill`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server r747000`; `cargo jackioh spec check`.
8. Mistake-rate test first (seconds, guides tuning): `r2214000_…_fewer_beginner_mistakes` reuses `random_turn_starts` over fixed seeds for ~120 turn starts; per position, miss (`skill_miss_action`) vs `random_action` on fresh fixed streams. Metric A denominator: a `Play` is legal; blunder = chose `EndTurn`. Metric B denominator: `greedy_action` returns `EndTurn`; blunder = chose an `Attack` (score-free comparison via `greedy_action`; rejected: exposing a new scoring API). Assert each miss rate below half the random rate with premise asserts (≥30 counted per metric); on failure panic with both rates (the required printed rates). Run with `-- --nocapture` and record passing rates for the PR.
9. Tune one dimension only: keep skills at 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1; try `AI_SKILL_MISS_TEMPERATURE` in {8.0, 4.0, 16.0} in that order, running `cargo run --release -p jackioh-server -- bot-calibrate` (default 100/pair) per candidate. Pick the smallest T passing step 8 whose every neighbour gap meets today's (167/153/156/140, within the fitted ±). At most two calibration runs; if none passes, move skills once to {0, 0.15, 0.4, 0.65, 1.0} at the most plausible T and report.
10. Re-measure the curve at the final skills with the README Skill-to-Elo protocol in a release build (`cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools`, then the `arena` runs per protocol), paste rows over `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` and `BOT_SEED_RATINGS` (`SKILL_ELO_ANCHOR` stays 1832.0, reference is full skill and unaffected; `BOT_CALIBRATION_GENERATION` stays 13, no AI promotion). Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server r747000_strength_seed_ratings_match_skill_curve` and `cargo test -p jackioh-server export_config` (wire must stay clean).
11. Docs and spec: new `docs/bot-calibration.md` Results subsection (T tried with mistake rates, curve runs, full `bot-calibrate` report, pasted rows); `crates/server/README.md` Skill-to-Elo + calibrate paragraphs; `spec/rulings/R2214000.md` (front matter `id/title/cards/proven_in` naming the three test files; text: kept roll, weighted miss, EndTurn weighed equally, draw discipline, redact/determinize hidden-info, rejected: uniform, per-strength temperature, in-search mixing); `spec/pending/2214.md` (`**[[R2214000]] … (issue #2214, <date>)**: …`); `R747000.md` title/cards "amended by R2214000" + pointer; §9.12 miss clause and §10.7 distinction sentence, each with `[[R2214000]]`.
12. Final gates: `cargo fmt --check`; clippy for the three crates; `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai skill`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server bots`; `cargo test -p jackioh-tools arena`; `cargo jackioh gate`; `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`. Quote the mistake rates and the calibration table in the PR.

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/skill.rs`: updated `r747000_zero_skill_equals_random_controller` (reproduces, zero `decisions`, differs from `Random`); new `r2214000_miss_returns_legal_actions_and_replays` (every pick over seeded states is in `legal_actions` and repeats on the same stream). Command: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai skill`.
- `crates/server/tests/bots/seat.rs`: updated `r747000_bot_seat_applies_strength_skill` (skill-0 arm expects the miss); new `r2214000_strength_zero_miss_is_legal_and_replays`; new `r2214000_strength_zero_miss_makes_fewer_beginner_mistakes` (both blunder rates below half of random's; failure panics print both rates; `-- --nocapture` shows passing rates). Command: `cargo test -p jackioh-server r2214000` plus `cargo test -p jackioh-server r747000`.
- `crates/tools/src/arena.rs` (unit tests): renamed `r2214000_a_zero_skill_agent_reproduces_but_differs_from_random`. Command: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools arena`.
- `crates/server/tests/bots/calibrate.rs`: run `cargo test -p jackioh-server calibrate`; change only asserts that pinned uniform-miss tallies.
- Gates: `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke; full-skill paths untouched, must stay green), `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`.

## Done when

- [ ] A strength-0 miss is always legal, drawn on the bot's own stream, and replays (new test green).
- [ ] The mistake-rate test shows the miss far less blunder-prone than `random_action` on both metrics, prints both rates on failure, and the PR quotes them.
- [ ] `docs/bot-calibration.md` records a `bot-calibrate` run where every neighbouring pair is apart, with errors.
- [ ] `r747000_strength_seed_ratings_match_skill_curve` passes on the new rows.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, `cargo jackioh gate`, `cargo jackioh spec check` are green (plus fmt, clippy for the three crates, tools arena tests, catalog/patches checks).

## Risks

- Determinism: the miss adds a determinization plus one softmax draw on the caller's stream; skill ends take no draw, as before. All four call sites pass their seat's own stream, never the match rng, so `(seed, log)` replays and hashes are unaffected.
- Hidden information: scoring runs on `redact` + `determinize` with frozen `GREEDY_EVAL`; the action list is `candidate_set` membership from the true state (legality only, no card text). The client sees nothing new (rule 7).
- Cost: one determinization plus per-candidate simulations per miss, far below a search hit; calibration has no clock and counts nodes only.
- Live drift: existing bots keep R610 ratings and re-settle; new seeds move only new bots and the ceiling. Anchor stays provisional until a person runs `bot-calibrate-live`.
- Yardstick frozen: `GREEDY_EVAL` values and the random policy (§10.7, fuzz, gates) are untouched; only the miss reads them.

## Open questions

None blocking. Steps 8–9 settle the temperature (and skills if needed); the reviewer confirms the pasted rows. One later person job, not this change: replace the provisional anchor via `bot-calibrate-live` once the reference has rated games against people.
```
